name: Doodle World
tagline: Generate a 3D world from a sketch, photo or prompt, then add and edit objects and characters by drawing or talking.
problem: The team wanted a creative playground where anyone can build and evolve worlds.
solution: Generative 3D services build a world and models; a whiteboard and language input add objects and NPCs in a Three.js scene with physics.
demo_moment: Team-described: sketch an object and see it appear in the world.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Living Culture Track Prize” among 160 submissions.
Lets creation keep going after the first generation.

lessons: Iteration, not one-shot generation, makes a creative tool feel like play.
